semiconductor_relevance: High — Quobly develops silicon-based quantum computers utilizing semiconductor manufacturing processes, positioning itself within the semiconductor industry.
summary: Quobly is a quantum computing company focused on developing scalable and manufacturable silicon-based quantum computers. Founded in 2022, it aims to industrialize quantum chips through strategic partnerships with key semiconductor players.
capabilities: Cloud deployment of quantum computing solutions

regional_presence.France: Headquartered in Grenoble, France, with a focus on leveraging local semiconductor expertise.
regional_presence.Singapore: Maintains an office in Singapore to support regional operations and partnerships.
